en: I see right through your disguise, $r. Number Two! Number Two kill!
The time has come for me to once again make my wares available to all who travel near Sentinel Hill! Come one, come all!
I have lost my Ring of the Gathering Storm. Are you able to replace it for me?
Bethekk, your priestess calls upon your might!
Welcome to Valanaar, $c.
%s is resurrected by a nearby ally!

Hello stranger, and welcome to the untamed majesty of Un'Goro Crater!$B$BMy name is Williden Marshal.  My sister, our companions, and I make up Marshal Expeditions - scientists and explorers of Azeroth's wild and great unknown.$B$BWe've hit a bit of a rough patch here, and we're looking for some help if you have the time!
VanCleef sends word that the plans are underway. But he's heard rumors about someone snooping about.
Take it easy, mon. I only train da warriors.
Our units are upgraded to Veteran, but I don't have enough supplies to upgrade them to Champion.
Ye won't find a gryphon master just anywhere around Dun Morogh, $glad : lass;.  Ye're going to have to go to Ironforge if ye want to take a gryphon somewhere.
Bah, that's goblin work!  Still, we have an orc here in Razor Hill that will teach you of such things.  Look for Mukdrak over near the forge.
Dirty beasts! Here they come!
Ya'll get a few minutes to wake up, but let's get started soon.
Thank you, little $r!
Having a good time?
Good job you two.  Now go have a seat.
Image dissipation in sixty seconds.
Hurray!  My doll!
We must hurry.
We've done it! Meet me back by Jer'kai above the Grim Totem camp.
My brother, no!
We elves have a long history.  Let us hope this history does not return to haunt us.

I wish it were true, $n, but it will take more than you alone to overcome the forces of Razelikh and his subordinates.$B$BGather a suitable group of adventurers and would-be heroes and free my men of their eternal torture! Eighteen stones you must shatter.$B$BFight hard and die with honor, $n.
What of this "Windlord"? Is Al'Akir real, or a creation of the cult?
I'm a test spirit healer.

Looks like you're too late, $c. We have all of the roast raptor that we need; killed, cooked and salted. Anyway, it looks like some of the others around here could use some help. You should go check with them. I'm going to see if they'll let me go home now.
Truly amazing, Gerard. How did you do it?
The end is now, Fordring.
Okay, here we go.  It's going to take about five minutes to shut this thing down through the ritual.  Once I start, keep the vermin off of me or it will be the end of us all!
Kazzak is supreme!
Inner ring of War Quarter where James Van Brunt work.  Him make us good chain.
If Hydraxis recruits more in his war, then it might shift the balance of power...
Help help!  I'm being repressed!
Your victory shall be short lived. The days of both the Alliance and Horde are coming to an end! The next time we meet shall be the last.
Lyria's the one you should talk to if you need some training.  She can usually be found out behind the smithy waiting for some armor or weapon to be finished.
Well, that should do it.  Come now, back to the shop to finish our business!
Gimme the purple ogre disguise!
Show no weakness!  Crush these foul creatures!

Ah... a customer! Talk to my greatest invention, the Vendor-Tron 1000. He has all your needs... some of the rarest items you will ever find on the market anywhere in Kalimdor... not to mention that his programming will not allow any bargaining, so the price you see is the price you pay.
Who has disturbed the altar of the goddess?
%s calls for his guardsmen.
%s is angered!
So, now that I'm the king... what have you got for me?!

About five months ago, the Venture Co.'s Stranglethorn division got their hands on a special poison from a shady merchant in Booty Bay named Crank Fizzlebub. Fizzlebub had apparently stolen the poison from Zanzil!$B$BYes, Zanzil the Outcast - the troll that was exiled from his own tribe due to the nature of his 'experiments' in necromancy.$B$BNaturally, once they had the poison, they proceeded to test it on each other. The results were disastrous.

Both the Horde and Alliance captains have taken to the field.  Our Captain Balinda Stonehearth directs the Stormpike forces from the Stonehearth Outpost, and the enemy Captain Galvangar barks orders from within Iceblood Garrison.$B$BTo battle!
A valuable skill First Aid is.  Our resident trainer, Nissa Firestone, can show ye how it's done.  Look for her on the southern side of The Great Forge at the Ironforge Physician.
